Class TriggerHandlerTest

@IsTest()
private class TriggerHandlerTest

Tests for the TriggerHandler base class. Validates trigger context routing, bypass API, loop count management, first-run tracking, field change detection, and method enable/disable functionality.

Group:
    Test Classes

Since:
    04/25/2021

Version:
    1.3


Change Log

  • 04/25/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version
  • 05/22/2022 - v1.1 - Added tests for loop count, field update validation, enable/disable, and first run
  • 03/29/2026 - v1.2 - Updated ApexDoc, assertions to use Assert class, and method naming conventions
  • 05/09/2026 - v1.3 - Added tests for bypass API using BypassScope class
